items.title: Dream Your Life Away
items.desc: Dream Your Life Away is the debut studio album by Australian singer-songwriter Vance Joy. It was released in Australia on 5 September 2014 via Liberation Music. The album was released on 9 September 2014 in the US via Atlantic Records and worldwide via Warner Music. The album has peaked to number 1 on the Australian Albums Chart. The album includes the singles From Afar, Riptide, Mess Is Mine, First Time and Georgia.

items.title: The Hunting Party
items.desc:
The Hunting Party is the sixth studio album by the American rock band Linkin Park. The album, self-produced by band members Mike Shinoda and Brad Delson, was released by Warner Bros. The album is the first since Meteora not to be produced with Rick Rubin, after producing the band's previous three studio albums.

The Hunting Party is a departure from the band's recent electronic rock sound of their previous two studio albums. The album, described by Mike Shinoda as simply "a rock record", serves a statement by the band against contemporary mainstream and active rock bands, accused by Shinoda as "trying to be other bands and playing it safe". …
items.d_es:
The Hunting Party —en español: La partida de caza— será el sexto álbum de estudio de la banda estadounidense de rock Linkin Park. Producido por los miembros de la banda Mike Shinoda y Brad Delson, será publicado por Warner Bros. Records el 13 de junio de 2014 en Alemania, Austria y Suiza, y el 17 de junio en América del Norte.

En 2010 y 2012 respectivamente, Linkin Park publicó A Thousand Suns y Living Things. Los álbumes, ambos producidos por Rick Rubin y Mike Shinoda, marcaron un cambio en la dirección musical de la banda, por el cual pasaban de un sonido hard rock, reconocible en Hybrid Theory y Meteora, a uno más experimental y «de vanguardia». …

items.title: This Is Acting
items.desc:
This Is Acting is the seventh studio album by Australian singer-songwriter Sia, released on 29 January 2016. The album was preceded by the release of the lead single, "Alive" on 24 September 2015.

This Is Acting is Sia's follow-up to her sixth studio album 1000 Forms of Fear. In December 2014, Sia told Spin that she had "two completed and ready to go" and wanted "2015 to look like it's just been fucked". She revealed details of This Is Acting for the first time in an interview published by NME in February 2015. In the article, she confirmed once again that work on the album was finished and that its content was "more pop" than her previous material. …

items.title: Pluto
items.desc: Pluto is the debut studio album by American hip hop recording artist Future. It was released on April 13, 2012, by Epic Records (Sony Music Entertainment), A1 Recordings and his own Freebandz label. The album features guest appearances from Drake, T.I., Juicy J, Trae tha Truth, Big Rube, R. Kelly and Snoop Dogg, while the production on the album was handled by Will-A-Fool, Sonny Digital and K.E. on the Track, among others.

items.title: Boardface
items.desc:
Boardface was the first album released by Gotye, released February 2003. The album, which primarily uses samples for its tracks, is a collection of songs he had created over the past few years after his band Downstares had dissolved. The album was originally self-released before it would be picked up by the label Lucky Numbers. 
The tracks on Boardface were originally featured on his self released album, "Gotye", which was created to send out to radio stations to make a name for himself. Triple J enjoyed the songs and decided to play them on their stations - that's when a label, Lucky Numbers, found out about him and decided to release Boardface under their label once it was complete. …

items.title: Весёлые улыбки
items.desc: 'Весёлые улыбки' (Happy Smiles) is t.A.T.u.'s third Russian studio album, released in October 21, 2008. The working title of the album was 'Управление отбросами' (Waste Management), which was retained in the English version album title.
items.d_es:
Весёлые Улыбки (Vesiolye Ulybki; Sonrisas Felices en español) es el tercer álbum de estudio del grupo t.A.T.u., que fue lanzado a la venta el 21 de octubre de 2008.

A lo largo de casi un año el nombre de trabajo del álbum fue «Управление Отбросами» (Upravlenie Otbrosami; Waste Management en inglés; Manejo de Desechos en español). Sin embargo, el 1 de septiembre de 2008 en el sitio oficial del grupo se publicó una entrevista con la revista Time Out Moscú, donde se decía que el álbum se llamaría «Весёлые Улыбки». El 3 de septiembre la cubierta del futuro álbum con la imagen de una mujer-cosmonauta fue publicada en el sitio. …

items.title: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess
items.desc:
The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess is the debut studio album by American singer and songwriter Chappell Roan, released on September 22, 2023, through Amusement Records, an imprint of Island Records owned by the album's producer, Dan Nigro. Roan wrote the album alongside Nigro beginning in 2020. The album received positive reviews from critics, who acclaimed its pop sound. Roan was born in Missouri, a state in the Midwest of America. 

Roan was signed to Atlantic Records and living in Los Angeles by 2017 when she released the EP School Nights, a "folk-leaning" project that she later admitted she "hated". …

items.title: From Zero
items.desc: From Zero is the eighth studio album by American rock band Linkin Park, released on November 15, 2024, through Warner Records and Machine Shop. It is Linkin Park's first studio album since One More Light (2017), and their first to feature new singer Emily Armstrong of Dead Sara on vocals, as well as the band's new drummer Colin Brittain. It is the band's first album without vocalist Chester Bennington following his death in 2017 as well as drummer Rob Bourdon due to his departure from the band. The album's title has a double meaning; it is a reference to the band's original name of Xero and also refers to the band's new chapter with Armstrong and Brittain. …

items.title: Harry’s House
items.desc: Harry's House is the third studio album by English singer and songwriter Harry Styles, released on May 20, 2022 under Columbia Records. Harry himself announced the title on March 23, 2022, unveiling its artwork, a 40-second trailer and the album's release date as May 20, 2022. In the trailer, Styles steps on the podium of a theatre and grins while a "house facade" rises near him and synthesisers play in the background. Harry's House will feature thirteen tracks. Joni Mitchell, who included a song called "Harry's House / Centerpiece" on her 1975 album "The Hissing of Summer Lawns", tweeted that she "love the title". …

items.title: V
items.desc:
V is the fifth studio album by American band Maroon 5. It was released on August 29, 2014, by Interscope Records. V was Maroon 5's first album to be released through Interscope after the band's previous label, A&M Octone Records, transferred them along with most of its artists to Interscope. The album also saw the return of keyboardist/rhythm guitarist/backing vocalist Jesse Carmichael after his absence from recording, touring and promoting Overexposed (2012).

V debuted at number one on the U.S. Billboard 200, selling 164,000 copies in the first week. The album produced three hit singles, "Maps", "Animals", and "Sugar", peaking at number 6, number 3, and number 2 on the U.S. …

items.title: American Beauty/American Psycho
items.desc: American Beauty/American Psycho is the sixth studio album by American rock band Fall Out Boy, released on January 16th, 2015 through Island Records as the follow-up to the band's comeback album Save Rock and Roll (2013). The band wrote music while on tour with Paramore mid-2014 and it developed into a new album. The album's release was preceded by the 4× platinum top 10 lead single "Centuries", released September 9th, 2014 while the album was still being completed. The album's title track was released as the second single in the UK on December 15th, 2014, receiving a radio premiere a month before on November 24th, 2014. American Beauty/American Psycho debuted at No. …

items.title: Cavalcade of Glee and Dadaist Happy Hardcore Pom Poms
Live at Sin-É
items.desc:
Several artist rose to fame by playing in the sin-é cafe in Manhattan. Jeff Buckley was one of these artists. This recording is the first ever record put out by Buckley in the form of a 1993 EP.

In 2003, six years after the death of Jeff Buckley, a so-called Legacy Edition was issued wich consisted of two cd discs. The cd's contain a few tracks that also were on the first entire album of Buckley, Grace. The other songs are all covers that range from Nina Simone (If You Knew) to the folk standard Dink's Song to the Pakastani performer Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan. The record also notes the stage banter as different songs wich are refered to as monologues.

items.title: A Moon Shaped Pool
items.desc:
A Moon Shaped Pool is the ninth studio album by the English rock band Radiohead, released as a download on 8 May 2016. The album's first two singles were "Burn the Witch" and "Daydreaming". CD and LP editions will be released by XL Recordings on 17 June 2016, followed in September by a "special edition" containing additional artwork and two bonus tracks. The album was produced by Nigel Godrich.

Radiohead began work on A Moon Shaped Pool intermittently after finishing the 2012 tour for their previous album, 2011's The King of Limbs. …

items.title: Radio Amor
items.desc:
It was January, 1996 on the Caribbean coast of Honduras. The musician in question was looking to catch a ride with a local vessel to the neighboring islands. There was one shrimping vessel in port that day, and its captain Jimmy willing to take disheveled hippies on board. He spoke some fragmented English, the boat set sail that evening. This album is dedicated to the idea of Jimmy the high-wire shrimper. Misplaced nautical charts, trade winds, shortwave miscommunication, midnight whispers, amorxxx.

Alien8 Recordings reissued Radio Amor in 2007 (originally released on Mille Plateaux in 2002) in order to maintain the availability of the work of one of the label's most important artists. …

items.title: Little Dark Age
items.desc:
Little Dark Age (abbreviated as LDA) is the fourth studio album by the American rock band MGMT, released on February 9, 2018, through Columbia Records. It was the band's first album of new material in over four years, after the release of their eponymous third studio album in September 2013. It's often known for being yellow.

After the band concluded touring at the end of 2014, members Andrew VanWyngarden and Benjamin Goldwasser took time off for most of 2015 before regrouping at the end of the year. The album was produced by the band with Patrick Wimberly and longtime collaborator Dave Fridmann. …

items.title: The Life of Pablo
items.desc:
The Life of Pablo is the seventh studio album by American rapper and producer Kanye West, released in 2016 through GOOD Music and distributed by Def Jam Recordings. The project is widely noted for blending hip-hop with prominent gospel, soul, and experimental elements, and for being presented as a work that continued to evolve after its initial release.

The album’s public development traced back to earlier West projects and working concepts during the mid-2010s. In the period leading up to release, West previewed music and ideas under prior working titles, including So Help Me God, before later shifting to SWISH and then Waves, reflecting an extended and highly visible creative process. …
items.d_es:
The Life of Pablo es el séptimo álbum de estudio de Kanye West. Originalmente se tituló So Help Me God, luego SWISH, y brevemente WAVES. El 9 de febrero de 2016, Kanye anunció que el título podría ser acrónimo como T.L.O.P., más tarde revelado para representar La vida de Pablo.

El álbum se estrenó el 11 de febrero de 2016 en el Madison Square Garden y se transmitió en vivo en cientos de teatros de todo el mundo y en el servicio de transmisión de TIDAL. Fue lanzado para su descarga y transmisión exclusivamente en TIDAL el 14 de febrero de 2016, con Kanye anunciando que no se vendería durante una semana después. …

items.title: Downtown Battle Mountain II
items.desc: Downtown Battle Mountain II is the fourth studio album by American post-hardcore band Dance Gavin Dance, released on March 8, 2011. This was the third release and last album to feature clean vocalist Jonny Craig upon his rejoining the band in 2010. He later parted ways with them in August 2012. The album is not a direct continuation of the band's first album Downtown Battle Mountain, but features the same line-up that recorded the first album (except for Sean O'Sullivan, who allegedly helped write one of the songs on the album) as original members Jonny Craig, Jonathan Mess and Eric Lodge all rejoined the band in 2010. …

items.title: Woodstock
items.desc: Woodstock is the eighth studio album by American rock band Portugal. The Man, released on June 16, 2017 through Atlantic Records. After having released Evil Friends in 2013, Portugal. The Man began work on a new project, under the working title Gloomin + Doomin. This album was eventually shelved, partly due to a conversation between John Gourley and his father and the discovery of a lost ticket stub from the Woodstock festival. Work began on the Woodstock album shortly thereafter, involving new music as well as material from the Gloomin + Doomin era. In 2014, the band often uploaded to their Instagram account while working on the album. …

items.title: FINAL FANTASY VIII オリジナル・サウンドトラック
Fine Line
items.desc:
Fine Line is the second studio album by English singer and songwriter Harry Styles, released on 13 December 2019 by Columbia and Erskine Records. The album's themes involve the initial excitement of meeting someone, breakups, and "having sex and feeling sad", as Styles has said himself. The record has been described as pop rock, with elements of prog-pop, psychedelic pop, folk, soul, funk and indie pop.

Supported by five singles—"Lights Up", "Adore You", "Falling", "Watermelon Sugar" and "Golden"—Fine Line debuted at number three on the UK Albums Chart and number one on the Billboard 200, making it Styles' second consecutive number-one album in the US. …

items.title: reputation
items.desc:
"Reputation" is the sixth studio album by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift. It was released on November 10, 2017, by Big Machine Records. Swift conceived the album during a hiatus from public activities in 2016 and 2017, following a period of extensive media scrutiny and controversy surrounding her public image.

Swift used an autobiographical songwriting approach on "Reputation", drawing on her romantic relationships, public disputes and experiences with celebrity culture. The album follows a narrative arc in which a narrator responds to conflict and public criticism before finding solace in love and personal relationships. …
items.d_es:
"reputation" es el sexto álbum de estudio de Taylor Swift, lanzado el 10 de noviembre de 2017. "reputation" muestra un cambio significativo en el sonido y la imagen de Taylor Swift. Este álbum marca una transición hacia un estilo más oscuro y electropop, alejándose del country y del pop más ligero que caracterizó sus trabajos anteriores. Las letras del álbum exploran temas de amor, fama, y las luchas que Swift ha enfrentado en los medios de comunicación.

El álbum incluye éxitos como "Look What You Made Me Do", "End Game" (con Ed Sheeran y Future) y "Delicate". …

items.title: The New Abnormal
items.desc:
"The New Abnormal" is the sixth studio album by American rock band The Strokes. It was released on April 10, 2020, through Cult and RCA Records. It comes nearly seven years after March 2013’s Comedown Machine, although the band had reunited briefly to release a three-track EP titled "Future Present Past" in June 2016.

The album title "The New Abnormal" is a reference to the present age of environmental disaster. “There were these huge fires in Los Angeles,” Julian about their time recording. “A lot of houses burned down but Shangri-La survived, by some miracle. …

items.title: Doris
items.desc:
Doris is Earl Sweatshirt’s debut album following the success of his 2010 mixtape, Earl.

Production began on approximately February 2012 as revealed through one of his tweets when he returned from Samoa. On December of the same year, he would announce the album’s title and various music outlets reported its supposed feature list. Earl would then confirm the release date for Doris on July 2013, to be on August 20th of that year, in addition to displaying the tracklist and cover for the first time.

Earl explores various themes throughout the bulk of Doris; mostly on reminiscing his past, his opinions about his current fame as a rapper, or just rapping on his drug use. …

items.title: Melodrama
items.desc:
Melodrama is the second studio album by New Zealand singer Lorde, released on June 16, 2017, through Lava and Republic Records and distributed through Universal. Following the breakthrough success of her debut album Pure Heroine, Lorde retreated from the spotlight, and travelled between New Zealand and the United States to examine the world around her. Initially inspired by her disillusionment with fame, she wrote Melodrama to capture heartbreak and solitude after her first breakup.

"Melodrama" has been described by critics as a loose concept album that explores the theme of solitude, in the framework of a single house party with the events and moods that entail it. …
items.d_es: Melodrama es el segundo álbum de la cantante y compositora neozelandesa Lorde, lanzado el 16 de junio del 2017 por Republic Records y Universal Music.​ El álbum fue grabado durante un período de 18 meses con el co-guionista y coproductor Jack Antonoff.

items.title: The Marble Index
items.desc: The Marble Index is the second solo album and third studio album by German musician Nico, which was released in November 1968 on Elektra Records. The avant-garde sound introduced in the album—a stark contrast with her folk pop debut, Chelsea Girl—was the result of the combination of Nico's droning harmonium and somber vocals, and producer John Cale's musical arrangements, which were inspired by modern European classical music. Nico envisioned the release as an attempt to get artistic legitimacy, thus also drastically changing the looks that had initially made her famous as a fashion model.

items.title: Midnights
items.desc:
"Midnights" is the tenth studio album by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift. It was released on October 21, 2022, through Republic Records. Described by Swift as a concept album about sleepless nights, it explores themes including regret, self-criticism, fantasies, heartbreak, infatuation, fame and personal relationships. Its lyrics include references to aspects of Swift's personal life and public image.

Swift produced the standard edition with Jack Antonoff. Sounwave, Jahaan Sweet and Keanu Beats each co-produced two tracks. "Midnights" incorporates synth-pop, electropop, bedroom pop and dream pop, with elements of electronica, hip-hop and R&B. …

items.title: Dawn FM
items.desc:
Dawn FM is the fifth studio album by Canadian singer-songwriter The Weeknd that was released on the 7th of January, 2022 by XO and Republic Records. The album was preceded by the lead single Take My Breath, which peaked at number six on the US Billboard Hot 100.

Intended to serve as a direct follow-up to his fourth studio album After Hours, Dawn FM features guest appearances from Jim Carrey, Tyler, the Creator and Lil Wayne. The album, which is primarily produced by the Weeknd, features additional contributions from Max Martin, Oscar Holter, Swedish House Mafia, Quincy Jones, and Oneohtrix Point Never, among others. …
items.d_es: Dawn FM es el quinto álbum de estudio del cantautor canadiense The Weeknd lanzado el 7 de enero de 2022 por XO y Republic Records.4​ Con la intención de servir como seguimiento directo de su cuarto trabajo discográfico After Hours (2020), Dawn FM cuenta con apariciones especiales de Tyler, the Creator, Lil Wayne y Jim Carrey. El álbum fue producido principalmente por The Weeknd y cuenta con la contribución adicional de Max Martin, Oscar Holter, Quincy Jones y Oneohtrix Point Never, entre otros

items.title: Purpose
items.desc: Purpose is the fourth studio album by Canadian singer Justin Bieber, released on November 13, 2015, by Def Jam Recordings. The album was preceded by the release of the lead single What Do You Mean? in August 28, 2015. Sorry was released as the second single from the album on October 23, 2015. I'll Show You was released as promotional single on November 1, 2015. Love Yourself was released as third single in November 09, 2015 and Company as fourth in March 08, 2016. The album serves as the follow-up to Bieber's previous studio album Believe.
items.d_es: Purpose es el cuarto álbum de estudio de el cantante canadiense Justin Bieber, fue lanzado el 13 de noviembre de 2015, por Def Jam Recordings. El álbum fue precedido por el lanzamiento del primer sencillo "What Do You Mean?" el 28 de agosto de 2015. "Sorry" fue lanzado como el segundo sencillo del álbum el 21 de octubre de 2015. Purpose sigue después del último álbum de Bieber estrenado en 2013, Journals .

items.title: So Good
items.desc: So Good is the second studio album by Swedish singer and songwriter Zara Larsson, and her first released internationally. It was released on 17 March 2017, through TEN Music Group and Epic Records. The album was originally scheduled to be released in May 2016 and then in January 2017; however, it was delayed so that changes could be made to a number of tracks.
items.d_es: So Good (Tan Bueno en español) es el próximo segundo álbum de estudio de la cantante y compositora sueca Zara Larsson, y el primero en ser lanzado mundialmente el 17 de marzo de 2017 a través de las discográficas Epic Records, Ten Music Group y Sony Music. El álbum en principio fue programado para ser lanzado en enero de 2017, sin embargo, se retrasó por razones desconocidas.

items.title: folklore
items.desc:
"folklore" is the eighth studio album by American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift. It was released as a surprise album on July 24, 2020, by Republic Records. Conceived during the COVID-19 pandemic, the album incorporates themes of escapism, nostalgia, romanticism, and memory. Swift recorded her vocals in a home studio in Los Angeles and worked remotely with producers Aaron Dessner and Jack Antonoff, who operated from studios in the Hudson Valley and New York City.

The album differs from much of Swift's earlier work by using fictional characters and interconnected narratives rather than relying primarily on autobiographical songwriting. …

items.title: No Love Deep Web
items.desc: No Love Deep Web is the second studio album by experimental hip hop group Death Grips. Originally called No Love, it was announced along with their debut album, titled The Money Store, that was released on April 24, 2012. On August 12, 2012, Death Grips announced that the album title was changed from No Love to No Love Deep Web. The album was initially scheduled for an October 23, 2012 release, however, the group self-released the album online for free after their record label, Epic, supposedly pushed the album's release to 2013, causing the band to break contract with the label.

items.title: thank u, next
items.desc:
thank u, next is the fifth studio album by American singer Ariana Grande, released on February 8, 2019 through Republic Records.

The title track of the album, thank u, next, was released on November 3, 2018 and a few minutes before the episode of Saturday Night Live, which had a promotional clip of Grande's ex-fiancé pete davidson making a joke, with Maggie Rogers, about the two's failed engagement. The song debuted at the top spot on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming her first song to do so.

The first promotional single, imagine was released on December 14, 2018. It will be the first song on the tracklist. …
items.d_es: Thank U, Next (en español "Gracias, Siguiente" - abreviado desde Thank You, Next y estilizado como thank u, next) es el quinto álbum de estudio de la cantante y compositora estadounidense Ariana Grande, lanzado el 8 de febrero de 2019 a través de Republic Records y Universal Music. Tras el lanzamiento de su anterior álbum de estudio, Sweetener (2018), Grande comenzó a trabajar en un nuevo álbum en octubre del mismo año, alistando a escritores y productores como Tommy Brown, Max Martin, Ilya Salmanzadeh y Andrew "Pop" Wansel. El álbum fue creado en medio de asuntos personales, incluida la muerte de su ex novio Mac Miller y la ruptura con el prometido Pete Davidson.

items.title: GOLDEN
items.desc:
GOLDEN is the debut solo studio album by South Korean singer Jung Kook, a member of the K-pop sensation group BTS, released on November 3, 2023, through Big Hit Entertainment.

On July 14, three months before, "Seven", featuring American rapper Latto, was released as the first single of the album. It debuted at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and achieved 35.4 million views on YouTube on its first day. It also debuted at #1 on Spotify Global with 15.9 million streams.

On September 29, "3D", featuring American rapper Jack Harlow, was released as the album's second single. …
items.d_es: Golden (estilizado en mayúsculas)2​ es el álbum de estudio debut del cantante surcoreano y miembro de BTS Jeon Jung-kook, publicado el 3 de noviembre de 2023, a través de Big Hit Music. Cuenta con la participación de Jack Harlow, Major Lazer, Latto y DJ Snake. Fue antecedido por los sencillos "Seven" y "3D"; el tercer sencillo, "Standing Next to You", fue publicado junto con el álbum.

items.title: 24K Magic
items.desc:
24K Magic (pronounced "twenty-four karat magic") is the third studio album by American singer Bruno Mars. It was released on November 18, 2016 by Atlantic Records as the follow-up to his second studio album Unorthodox Jukebox (2012). Recording sessions took place from 2015 to 2016 and the production was done entirely by Shampoo Press & Curl. Shampoo Press & Curl serve as the executive producers with the additional production by The Stereotypes, Jeff Bhasker and Emile Haynie. It marks the first time Mars has not produced under The Smeezingtons.

The title track "24K Magic" was released as the album's lead single on October 7, 2016. …
items.d_es: 24K Magic (en español: Magia de veinticuatro quilates) es el tercer álbum de estudio del artista estadounidense Bruno Mars. Fue lanzado el 18 de noviembre de 2016 por Atlantic Records. Registrando hasta el 15 de marzo de 2017 más de un millón novecientas mil copias en todo el mundo. La pista del mismo título fue lanzada como el primer sencillo del disco el 7 de octubre de 2016, y ha llegado al puesto número cuatro del conteo de éxitos del Billboard Hot 100. El segundo sencillo, That's What I Like, fue lanzado a finales de enero de 2017, y ha logrado obtener el puesto número 1 de la misma lista, convirtiéndose así en el séptimo sencillo de Mars que encabeza el Hot 100.

items.title: ASTROWORLD
items.desc: ASTROWORLD is the third studio album by American rapper Travis Scott. It was released on August 3, 2018 by Grand Hustle Records, Epic Records, and Cactus Jack Records. The album succeeds the release of Scott's album Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight, released in 2016, and the collaborative album Huncho Jack, Jack Huncho with Quavo, released in 2017. The album was supported by the single "BUTTERFLY EFFECT" with guest vocals from Kid Cudi, Frank Ocean, Drake, The Weeknd, James Blake, Swae Lee, Gunna, Philip Bailey, Nav, 21 Savage, Quavo, Takeoff, Juice WRLD, Sheck Wes, and Don Toliver, among others. …
items.d_es:
ASTROWORLD es el tan esperado tercer álbum de estudio de Travis Scott, luego de su lanzamiento en 2016 Birds in the Trap Sing McKnight. El álbum lleva el título de Six Flags AstroWorld, un popular parque de atracciones de Houston. El parque fue demolido en 2005. A pesar de que varios desarrolladores declararon reclamos para desarrollar el gran lote vacante en uso, desde entonces no se ha hecho nada con el espacio. En una entrevista de 2017 con GQ, Travis se lamentó de la prominencia del parque en Houston y su impacto en el álbum:

Así es como sonará, como quitarle un parque de diversiones a los niños. Lo queremos de vuelta. Queremos recuperar el edificio. Por eso lo estoy haciendo. …

items.title: Norman Fucking Rockwell!
items.desc:
Norman Fucking Rockwell! is the sixth studio album by Lana Del Rey, released on August 30, 2019, via Interscope and Polydor Records.

It features a soft rock sound with psych-rock songs and piano ballads, and includes references to various classic rock artists. The title is a nod to painter and illustrator Norman Rockwell.

To promote the album, five singles were released: "Mariners Apartment Complex", "Venice Bitch", "hope is a dangerous thing for a woman like me to have - but i have it", "Doin' Time" and "The greatest". Del Rey supported the album with her fifth concert tour, The Norman Fucking Rockwell! Tour, which ran from September 21 to November 30, 2019. …

items.title: Planet Her
items.desc:
Planet Her is the third studio album by American singer and rapper Doja Cat. It was released on June 25, 2021, by Kemosabe and RCA Records. The album, titled after a fictional planet created by Doja Cat, sees the artist experimenting with sounds that were new and unfamiliar to her, in an attempt to depart from the mainstream trends expected of pop artists. To further explain the name, she likened her musical style's shift in the record to travelling outside of Earth and into outer space.

A record that explores and incorporates a wide variety of genres, Planet Her is an amalgamation of pop, R&B and hip hop styles. …
items.d_es: Planet Her es el tercer álbum de estudio de la cantante, rapera y productora estadounidense Doja Cat, lanzado el 25 de junio de 2021 por los sellos Kemosabe Records y RCA Records. Este proyecto marcó un punto de inflexión en su carrera, consolidándola como una figura dominante en el pop contemporáneo. El título del álbum hace referencia a un planeta ficticio creado por la propia artista, donde todas las razas y especies del universo coexisten en armonía. Este concepto sirvió como base para la estética visual del disco, con cada video musical ambientado en distintas regiones de ese mundo imaginario. …

items.title: Manic
items.desc: Manic is the third studio album by American singer-songwriter Halsey. It was released on January 17, 2020. Its lead single, "Without Me", was released on October 29, 2018. The second single, "Graveyard", was released on September 13, 2019 along with the album pre-order. The first promotional single, "clementine" was released on September 29, 2019. The second and third promotional singles respectively, "Suga's Interlude", featuring Suga of BTS and "Finally // Beautiful Stranger" were released on December 6, 2019. The third single from Manic, "You should be sad", was released on January 10, 2020. …

items.title: MONTERO
items.desc:
MONTERO is the debut studio album by American rapper and singer Lil Nas X, released on September 17, 2021, by Columbia Records. It was supported by the singles "MONTERO (Call Me by Your Name)", "SUN GOES DOWN", "INDUSTRY BABY (feat. Jack Harlow)", and "THATS WHAT I WANT", the first and third of which topped the US Billboard Hot 100 while the latter reached the top 10.

The album has been mostly described as a pop rap record by critics. Primarily rooted in hip-hop and pop, the hook-dominated album incorporates trap beats and distorted hard rock, and draws elements from 2000s R&B and stadium ballads. …

items.title: 1000 Forms of Fear
items.desc:
1000 Forms of Fear is the sixth studio album by Australian singer-songwriter Sia, which comes after a wait of 4 years succeeding 2010's We Are Born. The album was released on July 4, 2014 and "Chandelier", served as the album's lead single. On June 2, 2014, "Eye of the Needle" was made available for download with album pre-orders on iTunes Store. 

The album received positive reviews from music critics, with many critics praising the album's darker mood, as well as the production and Sia's vocals and songwriting skills.
items.d_es:
1000 Forms of Fear —en español: mil formas de miedo— es el sexto álbum de estudio de la cantante y compositora australiana Sia, lanzado el 4 de julio de 2014 en Australia, mientras que para Norteamérica fue el 8 de ese mismo mes a través de los sellos discográficos Monkey Puzzle y RCA. Principalmente es un álbum electropop; también incorpora influencias de reggae e hip hop. Líricamente, el álbum muestra a Sia luchando para lidiar con la drogadicción y el trastorno bipolar.

1000 Forms of Fear ha recibido críticas positivas de la mayoría de críticos musicales que elogiaron la voz de Sia, así como el contenido lírico del álbum. …

items.title: Depression Cherry
items.desc:
Depression Cherry is the fifth studio album by American dream pop duo Beach House, released on August 28, 2015, through Sub Pop. It was recorded at Studio in the Country in Bogalusa, Louisiana, from November 2014 to January 2015. Reacting to their dissatisfaction with using live drums on tour to play songs from their previous album, Bloom, for Depression Cherry, the band returned to simpler song arrangements, similar to those of its first two studio albums. 

The album received mostly positive reviews from critics. Less than two months after releasing Depression Cherry, Beach House followed it up with their sixth album, Thank Your Lucky Stars.

items.title: If You Wait
items.desc: "If You Wait" is the debut studio album by London Grammar released in Sept 2013. The tracks on the album relate to life experiences during the transition from teenage years into adulthood. Sam Wolfson in The Guardian described the album as "the first quarter-life-crisis album."

items.title: Motion
items.desc: Motion is the fourth studio album by Scottish DJ and record producer Calvin Harris, released on 31 October 2014 by Fly Eye and Columbia Records. The album includes collaborations with English singer and songwriter Ellie Goulding, American musician Gwen Stefani of No Doubt fame, English musician John Newman, American singer Tinashe, American rapper Big Sean, Swedish DJ and record producer Alesso, Dutch-Moroccan DJ R3hab, Dutch DJ Ummet Ozcan, Dutch DJ and music production duo Firebeatz, English musical duo Hurts, American rock band HAIM and English band All About She. …
items.d_es: Motion es el cuarto álbum de estudio del disc jockey y productor británico Calvin Harris. Fue lanzado por la discográfica Columbia Records el 31 de octubre de 2014

items.title: Rock and Roll Night Club
items.desc: Rock and Roll Night Club is Mac DeMarco's debut mini-LP. It was recorded in 2012 in DeMarco's Montreal-based studio Jizz Jazz Studios and released through Captured Tracks on March 13, 2012.

items.title: Finally Rich
items.desc:
"Finally Rich" is the debut studio album by American rapper Chief Keef, released on December 18, 2012, by Glory Boyz Entertainment and Interscope Records. The album includes guest appearances from 50 Cent, Wiz Khalifa, Lil Reese, Rick Ross, Young Jeezy, Master P, French Montana, and Fat Trel, with most of the production handled by Chief Keef’s longtime collaborator Young Chop.

The album was supported by the singles "I Don't Like," "Love Sosa," and "Hate Bein' Sober," all of which contributed to its commercial success. …

Cigarettes After Sex is the debut studio album by American ambient pop band Cigarettes After Sex. It was released on June 9, 2017, by Partisan Records and received positive reviews from critics. As of May 2018, it had sold 19,194 copies in United Kingdom.

items.title: Right Thoughts, Right Words, Right Action
items.desc:
Right Thought, Right Words, Right Action is the 4th studio album by Scottish rock band Franz Ferdinand. It was due for release on the 26th August 2013, however it began appearing in stores the week before including availability in iTunes store and other various digital outlets. Almost all the tracks were performed live at various festival gigs prior to the release of the album. 

Right Action and Love Illumination were the two singles released on 7th July and 24th July respectively, their videos were released on youtube and made available for digital download.

items.title: Different World
items.desc: Different World is the debut studio album by Norwegian record producer Alan Walker. It was released on 14 December 2018 through MER Musikk and Sony Music Entertainment and includes his successful 2015 single "Faded". The album also succeeds a trilogy of releases leading up to the album, entitled World of Walker, which consisted of the singles "All Falls Down", "Darkside" and "Diamond Heart".

items.title: Be the Cowboy
items.desc:
Be the Cowboy is the fifth studio album by Japanese-American musician Mitski, released on August 17, 2018, through Dead Oceans. Produced by longtime collaborator Patrick Hyland, the album widens Mitski's palette with a return to the piano featured on her first two records alongside synthesizers, horns and the guitar that became her signature instrument.

Upon its release, Be the Cowboy received widespread acclaim from music critics, who later ranked it among the best albums of 2018. It was preceded by the singles "Geyser", "Nobody" and "Two Slow Dancers". …

items.title: Melophobia
items.desc:
Melophobia is the third studio album by American rock band Cage the Elephant. Recorded at St. Charles in Nashville, Tennessee and produced by Jay Joyce, the album was released on October 8, 2013, through RCA Records. It is also the final album that features lead guitarist Lincoln Parish.

For Melophobia, Cage the Elephant attempted to distance themselves from comparisons of the sound that influenced them, shutting themselves off from as much recorded music as possible. …

items.title: Sunbather
items.desc: 'Sunbather' is the second studio album by the American Blackgaze band Deafheaven. The Jack Shirley-produced album was released on June 11, 2013 through Deathwish Inc. 'Sunbather' was recorded in January 2013. The cover artwork for 'Sunbather' was designed by Nick Steinhardt of Touché Amoré who also designed the band's 2011 debut album Roads to Judah. The pink and orange colors on the cover are meant to resemble the color seen on the inside of one's eyelids when laying in the sun. The inspiration to have the title "Sunbather" written out in a simple, block formation was drawn from Pulp's 2001 album We Love Life.
items.d_es: Sunbather es el segundo álbum de estudio de la banda estadounidense de Blackgaze Deafheaven. El álbum producido por Jack Shirley fue lanzado el 11 de junio de 2013 a través de Deathwish Inc. Sunbather fue grabado en enero de 2013. El arte de la portada de Sunbather fue diseñado por Nick Steinhardt de Touché Amoré, quien también diseñó el álbum debut de la banda en 2011 Roads to Judah. Los colores rosa y naranja de la portada pretenden parecerse al color que se ve en el interior de los párpados cuando uno se tumba al sol. La inspiración para escribir el título "Sunbather" en una sencilla formación de bloques procede del álbum de Pulp de 2001 We Love Life.

items.desc: 25 is the third studio album by English singer-songwriter Adele, released on November 20, 2015 by XL Recordings and Columbia Records. The album is titled as a reflection of her life and frame of mind at 25 years old and is termed a "make-up record". Its lyrical content features themes of Adele "yearning for her old self, her nostalgia", and "melancholia about the passage of time" according to an interview with the singer by Rolling Stone, as well as themes of motherhood and regret. In contrast to Adele's previous works, the production of 25 incorporated the use of electronic elements and creative rhythmic patterns, with elements of 1980s R&B and organs. …

items.title: GNX
items.desc:
GNX is Kendrick Lamar’s surprise released sixth studio album, released on November 22nd, 2024 with no prior announcement or promotion. It's his first to be released outside of the Top Dawg Entertainment umbrella, and comes months after his highly-publicised feud with Drake.

For months, many rumors circulated amongst fans about the album’s release, though none seemed to materialize. …

items.title: Take Off Your Pants and Jacket
items.desc:
Take Off Your Pants and Jacket is the fourth album by blink-182. Produced by Jerry Finn, the album was released on June 12, 2001 through MCA Records. The title is a tongue-in-cheek pun on male masturbation ("take off your pants and jack it").

The album was a huge success, debuting at #1 and selling more than 350,000 copies in its first week on the Billboard 200, becoming the band's only album to do so. It has sold 12.5 million records worldwide, while going double Platinum in the United States. The album contains the hit singles "The Rock Show", "Stay Together For The Kids" and "First Date", while "Anthem Part Two" also received radio airplay. …
items.d_es: Es el cuarto álbum de estudio de Blink 182, fue lanzado el 12 de junio del 2001 por la discográfica MCA Records. Después del gran éxito comercial obtenido con Enema of the State, la banda entró al estudio en el 2000 para grabar el sucesor del álbum. En este álbum trabajaron con el factor *somos adolescentes y así es como pensamos* al igual que sus 2 predecesores Enema of the State y Dude Ranch. El título puede entenderse de 2 maneras: *Quítate los pantalones y la chaqueta* o *Quítate los pantalones y mastúrbate».

items.title: Mr. Morale & the Big Steppers
items.desc:
Mr. Morale & the Big Steppers is the fifth studio album by American rapper Kendrick Lamar. Released on May 13, 2022 in association with pgLang and Top Dawg Entertainment along with Aftermath Entertainment and Interscope Records. Lamar has stated that the album will be his last with Top Dawg Entertainment.

The album features narration by Whitney Alford and Eckhart Tolle, and guest appearances from Blxst, Amanda Reifer, Sampha, Taylour Paige, Summer Walker, Ghostface Killah, Baby Keem, Kodak Black, Sam Dew, Tanna Leone, and Beth Gibbons of Portishead. Lamar, who executive produced the album under the pseudonym Oklama, reunited with frequent collaborators Sounwave, J. …

items.title: In the Lonely Hour
items.desc: In the Lonely Hour is the debut studio album by English singer Sam Smith. It was released in the United Kingdom on 26 May 2014, via Capitol UK and Method Records. In the United States, it was released on 17 June 2014 through Capitol Records America. The album includes the hit singles "Money on My Mind" and "Stay with Me", both of which were number one in the UK; the latter becoming a hit worldwide, peaking in the top ten in over 20 countries, including reaching number two in the US. The album's third hit single, "I'm Not the Only One", reached number three in the UK and number five in the US. …

items.title: RUSH!
items.desc: Måneskin, an Italian Rock band with extraordinary music and style. Every since their debut in 2016, they have been growing in fame and popularity. On January 20th, 2023, RUSH!, Måneskin's 3rd studio album was released through epic records. RUSH! has 17 unique tracks, 3 of which are in Italian. This album is available for streaming on Spotify, Apple Music, Sound Cloud, and more.

items.title: Dangerous Woman
items.desc: Dangerous Woman is the third studio album by American singer Ariana Grande and was released on May 20, 2016, by Republic Records. The album is the follow-up to her second studio album My Everything (2014), and features guest appearances from Nicki Minaj, Lil Wayne, Macy Gray and Future. The album was originally titled Moonlight and had the song "Focus" as the intended lead single, however after finishing another track on the album she decided to change the album's name to Dangerous Woman and removed "Focus" from the album's tracklist, except in Japan, and the album's title track eventually replaced it as the lead single. …
items.d_es: Dangerous Woman (Mujer Peligrosa en español) es el título del tercer álbum de estudio de Ariana Grande. Se estrenó el 20 de mayo de 2016, bajo el sello discográfico de Republic Records. El álbum es el seguimiento de su anterior álbum de estudio, My Everything (2014). Los únicos sencillos hasta la fecha ha sido, "Dangerous Woman", el cual fue lanzado el 11 de marzo de 2016 e Into You, lanzado el 6 de mayo del 2016, con opiniones positivas de los críticos de música. "Be Alright" fue lanzado como sencillo promocional el 18 de marzo de 2016. …

items.title: Radical Optimism
items.desc:
'Radical Optimism' is the third studio album by the English-Albanian singer Dua Lipa. Released on 3 May 2024 by Warner Records. It's her first full-length studio album release in four years since 'Future Nostalgia' (2020).

Dua Lipa has mentioned working on her third album many times, including on the episode called "Megan Thee Stallion" on Dua’s podcast 'Dua Lipa: At Your Service'. Around this time, she also said her third album was already over 50% complete and even had a name she hadn’t revealed to the public. It’s been revealed that Dua was working on this album while her second studio album 'Future Nostalgia' was still in development. …
items.d_es: Radical Optimism es el tercer álbum de estudio de la cantante británica-albanesa Dua Lipa. Fue lanzado el 3 de mayo de 2024 a través de Warner Records.​ Fue precedido por tres sencillos: «Houdini», «Training Season» e «Illusion».

items.desc: 76 is the debut studio album by Dutch DJ and record producer Armin van Buuren. It was released on 23 September 2003 by United Recordings.

items.title: Sadnecessary
items.desc:
Sadnecessary is the debut studio album by German duo Milky Chance. It was released in Germany on 1 October 2013. A year later, it was released in the United States on 14 October 2014.

The album includes the singles 'Stolen Dance' and 'Down by the River'. The album peaked at number 14 in Germany, and charted at 17 on the Billboard 200 chart.

The group toured in support of the album, and on 5 December 2013, they won the 1Live Krone radio awards for the Best Single with 'Stolen Dance'.

items.title: So Far Gone
items.desc:
So Far Gone is the third mixtape by Canadian rapper Drake. It was released on February 13, 2009, under his October's Very Own label. The mixtape proved to be a major catalyst in the launching of Drake's career on an international scale, and was universally well received by professional critics and hip-hop fans alike.

The tracks "Best I Ever Had" and "Successful" were released as singles from the mixtape, and attained unexpected success on the US Billboard Hot 100. The mixtape was promoted with a release party in Toronto with Drake and LeBron James. Artists including Omarion, Lloyd, Lykke Li, Lil Wayne and Bun B provided guest vocals on the release. …

items.title: Voices
items.desc:
Vangelis - Voices (1995)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Voices is a 1995 album by Greek electronic composer and artist Vangelis.
Its music was used in the soundtrack for the 1998 documentary Deep Seas, Deep Secrets co-produced by The Learning Channel and Discovery Channel, together with music from Vangelis next album, Oceanic.
The track "Ask the Mountains" was also used as the music for the TV commercial for the Hotpoint/Ariston Aqualtis washing machine.

From allmusic
Review by Jim Brenholts
Voices is a deep and engaging album from an e-music legend, Vangelis. This CD predates his regular use of symphony orchestras to augment his synths. His synths are, however, very symphonic. …

items.title: Hot Pink
items.desc:
Hot Pink is the second studio album by American rapper and singer Doja Cat. The album was released on November 7, 2019, by Kemosabe. It features the singles "Juicy", featuring Tyga, "Bottom Bitch" and "Rules". The album features guest appearances from Smino, Tyga and Gucci Mane.

In an interview, Doja described her album in the following words: "I named the album 'Hot Pink' because I wanted people to feel that before they got into the music that it felt passionate, warm and welcoming," she said in a statement. "I think that the color hot pink describes those things the most. …
items.d_es:
Hot Pink es el segundo álbum de estudio de la cantante, rapera y productora estadounidense Doja Cat, lanzado el 7 de noviembre de 2019 por los sellos Kemosabe Records y RCA Records. Este proyecto marcó una evolución significativa respecto a su debut Amala, alejándose del sonido dancehall y adoptando una mezcla más refinada de pop, hip hop, R&B, funk y soul.

Durante el proceso creativo, Doja Cat dejó de consumir marihuana, lo que según ella le permitió escribir con mayor claridad y enfoque. …

items.title: the Glow, pt. 2
items.desc:
The Glow Pt. 2 is the third studio album by American indie folk and indie rock project the Microphones. It was released on September 11, 2001, through K Records and later through P.W. Elverum & Sun, Ltd. Recording was done on analog equipment at Dub Narcotic, Olympia, Washington, from May 2000 to March 2001. The album takes influences from numerous music genres such as black metal, ambient and avant-garde, as well as non-musical sources like the American drama television show Twin Peaks and primary member Phil Elverum's relationship to Khaela Maricich. Elverum was responsible for the album's production in its entirety.

Musically, The Glow Pt. …

items.title: Smoke + Mirrors
items.desc: Smoke + Mirrors is the second studio album by American pop rock band Imagine Dragons. The album was recorded during 2014 at the band's home studio in Las Vegas, Nevada. Self-produced by members of the band along with English hip-hop producer Alex da Kid, the album was released by Interscope Records and Grant's Kidinakorner label on February 17, 2015, in the United States.

1999 is the debut mixtape by American rapper Joey Bada$$. It was released on June 12, 2012.

The album was met with widespread critical acclaim, and general interest upon its release. It features production by Chuck Strangers, Lewis Parker, Lord Finesse, MF DOOM and J Dilla, among others.

In May 2022, Joey Badass announced that his next album would be a sequel to 1999, named 2000. It was released shortly after 1999's tenth anniversary on July 22, 2022.

1999 was a free digital download, but after B4.Da.$$ was released, 1999 and another mixtape Summer Knights became available on iTunes for sale. On June 12, 2018, the album was released on Spotify and TIDAL. …

items.title: Roads to Judah
items.desc:
Recorded by Jack Shirley (guitarist of Comadre), "Roads to Judah", is a hypnotic thirty eight minute plunge into hazy musical darkness. A dizzying hybrid of Shoegaze shimmer, Hardcore vulnerability, and Black Metal intensity.

From the opening drone of the album it's as if we are are peering through a dream into the private world that is Deafheaven's "Roads to Judah". Layers and layers of instrumentation build, tangle and swirl before the real onslaught begins. A ferocious drum fill then thrusts us from the serene into a free fall, as if the ground below suddenly gave way. From there we plummet through one awe inducing sonic fog into the next, blurring the traditional lines of song. …

items.title: Death of a Bachelor
items.desc: Death of a Bachelor is the fifth studio album by American rock band Panic! at the Disco, released January 15, 2016 on Fueled by Ramen and DCD2. It is the follow-up to the band's fourth studio album, Too Weird to Live, Too Rare to Die!, with the entire album written and recorded by lead vocalist/multi-instrumentalist Brendon Urie, among external writers. It is the band's first album to not feature drummer Spencer Smith and also follows bassist Dallon Weekes' departure from the official line-up, subsequently becoming a touring member once again. …

items.title: BALLADS 1
items.desc: BALLADS 1 is the debut studio album by Japanese singer-songwriter Joji. It serves as a follow-up to In Tongues EP, his first project as Joji, and Pink Season, his only album released under the now-retired alter-ego Pink Guy. It was released on 26 October 2018 through 88rising and 12Tone Music. The album debuted at number three on the US Billboard 200 with 57,000 album-equivalent units, as well as number one on the US Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums chart. The album was certified platinum by the RIAA in October 2021. …

items.title: beerbongs & bentleys
items.desc: beerbongs & bentleys is the second studio album by American rapper and singer-songwriter Post Malone, released via Republic Records on April 27, 2018. The album features guest appearances from Swae Lee, 21 Savage, Ty Dolla Sign, Nicki Minaj, G-Eazy and YG. The album was supported by the singles "Rockstar (feat. 21 Savage)", "Candy Paint", "Psycho (feat. Ty Dolla Sign)", "Ball for Me (feat. Nicki Minaj)" and "Better Now". The album cover is a reference to Kanye West's 'Yeezus'.
items.d_es: Beerbongs & Bentleys (estilizado en letras minúsculas) es el segundo álbum de estudio del rapero estadounidense Post Malone, lanzado por Republic Records el 27 de abril de 2018. El álbum cuenta con apariciones especiales de Swae Lee, 21 Savage, Ty Dolla Sign, Nicki Minaj, G -Eazy y YG. El álbum fue promocionado con tres singles: "Rockstar", "Candy Paint" y "Psycho".

items.title: Hail to the King
items.desc: Hail to the King is the sixth studio album by American heavy metal band Avenged Sevenfold, was released on August 27, 2013 on Warner Bros. Records in the United States. The album was produced by Mike Elizondo. This marks the first album with new drummer Arin Ilejay, who joined the band as a touring drummer in 2011 before becoming an official member in 2013. This is also the first Avenged Sevenfold album without any musical contributions from the band's late drummer, Jimmy "The Rev" Sullivan.
items.d_es:
Hail to the King es el sexto álbum de estudio de la banda de heavy metal Avenged Sevenfold, que saldrá a la venta el 27 de agosto de 2013, bajo el sello Warner Bros. Records y producido por Mike Elizondo.Durante el 21 de agosto del 2013 se dio un streaming , por lo cual ya se conocen todas la canciones , aunque salga el 27 de agosto.

Será el primer álbum que grabará Arin Ilejay como batería de Avenged Sevenfold, y por tanto, también el primer álbum de la banda sin la participación del baterista y fundador de la banda, The Rev, quien falleció el 28 de diciembre de 2009. En 2010 se lanzó el álbum Nightmare, en el cual se incluyeron las grabaciones de «The Rev». …

items.title: Oncle Jazz
items.desc:
Oncle Jazz is the first album after frontwoman Emma Proulx joined the band. Men I Trust has said:

“We took our time to craft it with love and we’re very proud of how it came together. This album was mixed quietly so it sounds warmer and more natural.“

items.title: Salad Days
items.desc: Salad Days is the second full-length studio album by Canadian musician Mac DeMarco released on April 1, 2014 through Captured Tracks. Following the debut releases of Rock and Roll Night Club and 2 in 2012 and the extensive touring for both releases in 2013, DeMarco worked on material for his next album at his Bedford-Stuyvesant apartment in Brooklyn. Salad Days garnered acclaim from critics, and debuted at number 30 on the Billboard 200. The album spawned two singles: Passing Out Pieces and Brother. To promote the album, DeMarco went on a tour that spanned across North America, South America and Europe. …
items.d_es: Salad Days es el segundo álbum de estudio de larga duración del músico canadiense Mac DeMarco, lanzado el 1 de abril de 2014 a través de Captured Tracks.

items.title: GUTS
items.desc:
GUTS is the second studio album by American singer-songwriter Olivia Rodrigo. It was released on September 8, 2023, Via Geffen Records/Interscope Records. It was preceded by its lead single "Vampire", released on June 30, 2023. It debuted atop the Billboard Hot 100, scoring Rodrigo her third number-one single in the United States. The second single, "bad idea right?", was released on August 11, 2023.

GUTS was released on September 8, 2023, via CD, cassette, streaming platforms, and three box set editions. Preorders for the album began on June 26, 2023. …
items.d_es: GUTS (estilizado en mayúsculas) es el segundo álbum de estudio de la cantante filipinoestadounidense Olivia Rodrigo. Fue lanzado el 8 de septiembre de 2023, a través de Geffen Records. El álbum fue escrito por Rodrigo y el productor Dan Nigro, con colaboraciones en autoría de Julia Michaels y Amy Allen. Rodrigo concibió Guts como un intento para reflejar el proceso de madurez que ella experimentó al finalizar sus años de adolescencia. …

items.title: My Everything
items.desc: My Everything is the second studio album by American recording artist Ariana Grande. The lead single "Problem" was released on April 28, 2014 and features Australian rapper Iggy Azalea. It debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 with first week sales of over 400,000, and has risen to No. 2. The next single, "Break Free" featuring Russian-German musician and producer Zedd, premiered on July 2, 2014 and has since risen to No. 4 on the Hot 100. My Everything was released on August 22, 2014, by Republic Records.

Origins
items.desc: Origins is the fourth studio album by the American pop rock band Imagine Dragons, released on November 9, 2018 by Kidinakorner, Polydor Records and Interscope Records.

“?” is the second studio album by American rapper and singer-songwriter XXXTentacion and his last studio album to be released three months before his death. It was released through Bad Vibes Forever, Caroline Distribution, and Capitol Music Group on March 16, 2018, and primarily produced by frequent collaborator John Cunningham, it includes a wide range of guest appearances from PnB Rock, Travis Barker of Blink-182, Joey Badass, Matt Ox, Rio Santana, Judah, and Carlos Andrez, and also succeeds the release of his debut studio album 17 (2017) and the extended play A Ghetto Christmas Carol (2017).

items.title: Unreal Unearth
items.desc: Unreal Unearth is the third studio album by Irish musician Hozier, released on 18 August 2023. It contains the singles "Eat Your Young" and "Francesca", along with the song "All Things End". Hozier is on a tour of Ireland, the UK and North America in support of the record from June to December 2023.

items.title: Pray for the Wicked
items.desc: Pray for the Wicked is the sixth studio album by American rock band Panic! at the Disco. The album was released on June 22, 2018 on Fueled by Ramen and DCD2 as the follow-up to the band's fifth studio album, “Death of a Bachelor”. The album was preceded by the release of four songs from the album: “(Fuck A) Silver Lining”, “Say Amen (Saturday Night)”, “High Hopes” and “King of the Clouds”.

items.desc:
"Legends Never Die" is the third studio album by American rapper and singer Juice WRLD and first posthumous project following his death from a drug overdose on December 8, 2019. The title was originally rumored to be named 'The Outsiders' based on a freestyle he did within an Instagram live, but was later confirmed to be Legends Never Die four days before the release. The album was officially released on July 10, 2020, through Grade A Productions and Interscope Records.

The first promotional single for the album was titled “Righteous“ and released in late April 2020. …

items.title: Racine carrée
items.desc: Racine carrée (stylised √, English translation: Square root) is the second studio album by Belgian musician Stromae. It was released digitally on 16 August 2013 and three days later physically in France and Belgium. Recorded in an attic, Stromae expressed his desire to incorporate Caribbean and African musical influences along with his signature 1990s-inspired dance beats. The album explores themes as diverse as alienation from social networks, relationship issues, discrimination, cigarettes and lung cancer, AIDS and absent father figures. …

items.title: Interstellar: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack
items.desc: Interstellar: Original Motion Picture Soundtrack is the soundtrack album to the 2014 film Interstellar directed by Christopher Nolan. The film score is composed by Hans Zimmer who previously scored Nolan's Batman film trilogy and Inception. The soundtrack garnered critical acclaim. Prior to its digital release, it was nominated for an Academy Award and Original Score at the Hollywood Music in Media Awards. The soundtrack was released on November 17, 2014 via the WaterTower label.

items.title: Trench
items.desc: Trench is the fifth studio album by American musical duo Twenty One Pilots, released on October 5, 2018 through Fueled by Ramen. It is primarily an indie pop album with influences from hip hop, alternative rock, synthpop, and R&B. It is the band's first studio album in three years, after the breakthrough success of their previous album, Blurryface (2015). Recorded in secret during a year-long public silence, it is a concept album which explores mental health, suicide and doubt, themes prominently featured in the band's previous works, framed in the metaphorical city of Dema and the surrounding valley known as "Trench". …
items.d_es: Trench (estilizado como TRENCH) es el quinto álbum de estudio del dúo estadounidense Twenty One Pilots. El álbum fue lanzado el 5 de octubre del 2018. Cuenta con cuatro sencillos, los dos primeros, Nico and the Niners y Jumpsuit, fueron lanzados el 11 de julio de 2018, Levitate fue lanzado el 8 de agosto como tercer sencillo, un cuarto sencillo, My Blood, fue lanzado el 27 de agosto. Este es el regreso del dúo tras 2 años sin lanzar material nuevo desde su exitoso cuarto álbum Blurryface (2015), y los singles Heathens y Cancer (2016).

items.title: Strange Trails
items.desc: Lord Huron released their sophomore album "Strange Trails" on April 6, 2015, in the United Kingdom and April 7, 2015, in the United States. The album debuted on the Billboard 200 at No. 23, and Folk Albums at No. 1, and No. 10 on the Top Album Sales chart, with 18,000 copies sold.

items.title: Nectar
items.desc:
Nectar is the second studio album by Joji, following his successful debut record, BALLADS 1, released in October of 2018.

After initially announcing a July 2020 release date, Joji postponed the album to September 25, 2020 in response to the COVID-19 pandemic and the Black Lives Matter protests.

The album boasts a variety of featured singers, rappers, and producers, including: Diplo, Omar Apollo, Lil Yachty, rei brown, BENEE, and Yves Tumor.

The first single from the record, “Sanctuary,” was released on June 14, 2019. The record’s second single, “Run,” released on February 7, 2020. …

items.title: The Hybrid
items.desc:
The Hybrid is the debut studio album by American rapper Danny Brown, released March 16, 2010.
The album, which was preceded by a number of free mixtapes, was also released as a free download, by Washington, DC record label Rappers I Know. The label later published the album on vinyl. A deluxe edition of the album was released for sale on Amazon on January 18, 2011, and later on iTunes on February 8, 2011, via Hybrid Music.

items.title: DECIDE
items.desc:
DECIDE is the second studio album from Djo and is the follow-up to his 2019 album “Twenty Twenty”. The album’s first single “Change” was released in June of 2022, and its second single “Gloom” was released on July 25, 2022

On June 22, 2022 Djo officially revealed the album's name and release date alongside the release of the first single Change in a social media post saying:

“CHANGE” IS HERE. FROM MY NEW ALBUM DECIDE OUT SEPT 16. (LINK IN BIO)

On July 28, 2022, Djo would announce the album's pre-save link for the album alongside its cover art and tracklist.

The album would receive two more singles "Figure You Out" on August 26, 2022, and "Half Life" two weeks later on September 9, 2022. …

items.title: After Laughter
items.desc:
After Laughter is the fifth studio album by American rock band Paramore, released on May 12, 2017 through Fueled by Ramen as a follow-up to Paramore (2013). It is their first album since the return of drummer Zac Farro, who left the band with his brother Josh in 2010, and the departure of former bassist Jeremy Davis, who left the band in 2015.

The album's lead single, "Hard Times" was released on April 19, 2017 along with the music video and a pre-order of the album.

items.title: Hadestown
items.desc: Hadestown is the fourth album by Vermont-based Anaïs Mitchell, and was released by Righteous Babe Records in the U.S. on March 9, 2010. The album, a concept album, follows a variation on the Ancient Greek myth of Orpheus and Eurydice, where Orpheus must embark on a quest to rescue his wife Eurydice from the underworld. It has been advertised as a 'folk opera'. Several of the songs feature singers other than Mitchell, including Justin Vernon (better known as lead vocalist and guitarist of Wisconsin-based band Bon Iver), Ani DiFranco, Greg Brown, and Tanya, Petra and Rachel Haden (referred to in the track listing as 'The Haden Triplets').

items.title: Drunk
items.desc: Drunk is the third studio album by American musician Thundercat. It was released on February 24, 2017 by Brainfeeder. It features guest appearances from Kenny Loggins, Michael McDonald, Kendrick Lamar, Wiz Khalifa, Mac Miller, and Pharrell. It is his first studio album in nearly four years, his last studio album being Apocalypse. Drunk received positive reviews from music critics. A ChopNotSlop remix from OG Ron C, DJ Candlestick, & The Chopstars entitled 'Drank' was released as a special edition purple vinyl record.

items.title: Illuminate
items.desc:
Illuminate is the second studio album by Canadian singer and songwriter Shawn Mendes. Released on September 23, 2016, through Island Records and Universal Music Group.

Treat You Better was released as the lead single from the album on June 3, 2016. The music video was released on July 12, 2016, and features a storyline about an abusive relationship. Since it's release, "Treat You Better" has peaked at number 6 on the Billboard Hot 100. …

items.title: E•MO•TION
items.desc:
Emotion (stylized as E•MO•TION) is the third studio album by Canadian singer Carly Rae Jepsen. It was released on June 24, 2015 in Japan and on August 21, 2015 worldwide through 604, School Boy, and Interscope Records. Looking to transition from the "pure pop"-oriented nature of Kiss, Jepsen found inspiration in 1980s music and alternative styles. She enlisted a team of indie-pop collaborators including Dev Hynes, Ariel Rechtshaid and Rostam Batmanglij.

Emotion received highly positive reviews from contemporary music critics, who placed the album on many year-end lists. …
items.d_es:
Emotion (estilizado como E•MO•TION) es el tercer álbum de estudio de la cantante canadiense, Carly Rae Jepsen. Fue lanzado el 24 de junio de 2015, de Japón y fue puesto en libertad el 21 de agosto de 2015, de América del Norte y en todo el mundo a través de 604 expedientes, School Boy Records, y Interscope Records.

Los críticos musicales aclamaron su cohesión como un álbum de pop y complementan su producción global y la composición de Jepsen, también lo elogió como un paso adelante respecto a su predecesor. El segundo single del álbum, "Run Away With Me", fue nombrado el tema destacado del álbum por muchos críticos por igual. …

items.title: Notes From the Underground
items.desc: Hollywood Undead's third full-length album Notes From The Underground emerges directly from that same place behind the curtain, underneath the veneer, and inside the darkest heart of their city. These are their Notes scribed in tears, blood, and truth.

items.title: Carrie & Lowell
items.desc:
Carrie & Lowell is the seventh studio album by American musician Sufjan Stevens, released through Asthmatic Kitty on March 31, 2015. Unlike Stevens's previous studio album, the electronic The Age of Adz, Carrie & Lowell is sparsely instrumental and marks a return to the performer's indie folk roots.

The album was released to high critical acclaim, with many critics calling it one of Stevens's best.

items.title: Sweetener
items.desc:
Sweetener is the fourth studio album by American singer Ariana Grande. It was released on August 17, 2018, through Republic Records. The album is the follow-up to her third studio album Dangerous Woman (2016), and features guest appearances from Pharrell Williams, Nicki Minaj and Missy Elliott.

The album debuted at number 1 on the US Billboard 200 earning 231,000 album-equivalent units in its first week of which 127,000 were from pure sales, thus becoming Grande's third release to reach the top position in the country and subsequently marking the largest opening week numbers of her career. …
items.d_es: Sweetener (en español "Edulcorante") es el cuarto trabajo discográfico de la cantante y compositora estadounidense Ariana Grande. Este es producido por la misma cantante, siendo el primer álbum de estudio donde la cantante se involucra en dicho ámbito junto con el productor sueco Max Martin y los estadounidenses Pharrell Williams y Savan Kotecha, entre otros y cuenta con colaboraciones de Nicki Minaj, Pharrell Williams y Missy Elliott. …

items.title: Prequelle
items.desc: Prequelle is the fourth studio album by Swedish heavy metal band Ghost. It was released on June 1, 2018. The albums first single, "Rats", was released ahead of the album on April 13, and as of June, had peaked at number four on the Billboard Mainstream Rock Songs chart.

items.title: Shawn Mendes
items.desc: Shawn Mendes is the third studio album by Canadian singer Shawn Mendes, released through Island Records on May 25, 2018. It is primarily a pop record, with ingrained influences of pop rock, blues and R&B. Mendes worked with Ryan Tedder, Julia Michaels, John Mayer, Ed Sheeran, Johnny McDaid, Camila Cabello and Khalid. Among the producers are Tedder, Louis Bell, Ian Kirkpatrick, with Mendes serving as an executive producer.

items.title: Stoney
items.desc: Stoney is the debut studio album by American rapper and singer Post Malone. It was released on December 9, 2016, by Republic Records. The album features guest appearances from Justin Bieber, Kehlani, and Quavo. The deluxe edition was released on the same day. It features an additional guest appearance from 2 Chainz.

items.title: All My Demons Greeting Me as a Friend
items.desc:
All My Demons Greeting Me As A Friend is the debut studio album by Norwegian singer AURORA, released on March 11, 2016 through Decca, Glassnote and Petroleum Records following the release of her debut extended play Running With The Wolves. Lyrical nature themes throughout the record present vivid lyricisms about fantasy, heartache, life, and death.

Six singles supported the album, all of which were supplemented by accompanying music videos. Runaway became a sleeper hit six years later and peaked at number #1 on the Billboard Bubbling Under Hot 100 in the United States. …

items.title: Teflon Don
items.desc:
"Teflon Don" is the fourth studio album by American rapper Rick Ross, released on July 20, 2010, on Maybach Music Group, Slip-n-Slide Records and Def Jam Recordings. Production for the album took place from 2009 to 2010 and was handled by several record producers, including Clark Kent, No I.D., The Olympicks, J.U.S.T.I.C.E. League, Lex Luger, Danja, The Inkredibles, The Remedy, and Kanye West.

The album debuted at number two on the US Billboard 200 chart, selling 176,300 copies in its first week. It attained some international charting and produced three singles with moderate Billboard chart success. …

items.title: Don't Forget About Me, Demos
items.desc:
Don’t Forget About Me, Demos is Dominic Fike’s first commercial release under Columbia Records and consists of eight songs, originally six.

Following his arrest in 2017, Fike made a rough draft of his EP while on house arrest and originally released it before reporting to Collier County Jail to serve the rest of his sentence. Upon release, Dominic Fike signed to a reported $4 million label contract with Columbia Records and officially released Don’t Forget About Me, on October 16, 2018.

The Demo Tape features production from Fike himself as well as Capi. on “3 Nights” and Christopher Santos on “Socks.”

items.title: Queen of the Clouds
items.desc:
Queen of the Clouds is the debut studio album by Swedish singer-songwriter Tove Lo, released on September 24, 2014, via Island Records. It is primarily a electropop, dance-pop and synth-pop record. Lyrically, the album's themes center on the stages of a relationship, including passion, love and break-ups.

The album follows her debut EP Truth Serum (2014) and includes the successful singles "Habits (Stay High)" and "Talking Body".

items.title: eternal sunshine
items.desc:
eternal sunshine is the seventh studio album by American singer Ariana Grande, released on March 8, 2024 through Republic Records. It is her first new body of work in over three years, following the release of Positions (2020). 

Written and produced by Grande, Max Martin, Ilya Salmanzadeh, and Oscar Görres amongst others, eternal sunshine is a pop and R&B album with dance music influences, particularly synth-pop and house, characterized by mid-tempo synthesizers, subtle guitar and string elements.

Grande derived the album's title from the 2004 American film Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind. …
items.d_es: "Eternal Sunshine" (estilizado en minúsculas; Luz solar eterna - en español) es el séptimo álbum de estudio de la cantautora y actriz estadounidense ganadora del GRAMMY Ariana Grande. Lanzado el 8 de marzo de 2024, es el álbum más exitoso de 2024 hasta la fecha. Este álbum tiene 13 temas, 2 de estos son interludios, todos los temas ya entraron al Billboard Hot 100, además el álbum está en el puesto #1 en el Billboard 200. Este álbum ya tiene dos #1 en el Hot 100, siendo: " yes, and?" y "we can't be friends (wait for your love)".

items.title: Song Islands
items.desc: Song Islands is a collection of singles and rare songs by the Microphones, recorded between 1998 and 2002.

items.title: BADLANDS
items.desc: BADLANDS is the debut studio album by American singer-songwriter Halsey. It was released on August 28, 2015 through Astralwerks. Musically, Badlands is a electropop, dark pop, alternative pop, and synth-pop record and features industrial music undertones. Halsey wrote every song on the album when she was 19, while production was handled by a number of producers. Norwegian producer Lido was one of the main producers on Badlands. The album was described by Halsey as lacking a "proper radio hit".
items.d_es: Badlands (estilizado como BADLANDS) es el primer álbum de estudio de la cantautora estadounidense Halsey, publicado el 28 de agosto de 2015 por el sello discográfico Astralwerks. El nombre "Badlands" hace referencia, a una ocurrencia de Halsey mientras escribía el álbum, para dar un lugar físico como la metáfora perfecta de desolación y soledad. Musicalmente, el álbum es principalmente electropop, también descrito como electropop e indie pop. Badlands recibió críticas positivas de expertos contemporáneos de música, que comentan que es "la cohesión de una dama enojada". Debutó en el puesto número dos en el Billboard 200 con un promedio de ventas de 115 000 copias en la primera semana. …

items.title: 2014 Forest Hills Drive
items.desc:
J. Cole
2014 Forest Hills Drive

2014 Forest Hills Drive is the third studio album by American hip-hop recording artist J. Cole. It was released on December 9, 2014, by Dreamville, Roc Nation, and Columbia Records. Recording sessions for the album took place throughout 2014, with production primarily handled by J. Cole himself, alongside contributions from producers such as Illmind, Vinylz, Phonix Beats, and Willie B. The album was announced three weeks prior to its release and was supported by minimal marketing, with no lead singles or significant promotional efforts occurring before its launch.

The album is noted for its introspective lyrics and cohesive production, reflecting on J. …

items.title: Divinely Uninspired to a Hellish Extent
items.desc: Divinely Uninspired to a Hellish Extent is the debut album by Scottish singer-songwriter Lewis Capaldi. It was released on 17 May 2019 through Vertigo Records in Europe and Capitol Records in the United States, and distributed globally by Universal Music. It includes the top 10 single "Grace", the UK and US number one single "Someone You Loved" and the album's lead single "Hold Me While You Wait", among several songs previously included on Capaldi's 2018 EPs Bloom and Breach. Capaldi went on a world tour in support of the record in May 2019, and finished the tour in October 2019. …

items.title: The Raven That Refused to Sing (and Other Stories)
tags: one solo can kill a man
items.desc: The Raven That Refused to Sing (and Other Stories) is the third solo album by British musician Steven Wilson. Each track on the album is based on a story of the supernatural. Alan Parsons, well known in part for his involvement in Pink Floyd's The Dark Side of the Moon (1973), was responsible for engineering the album.

items.title: Rare
items.desc:
Rare is the third solo studio album by American singer Selena Gomez. It was released on January 10, 2020, through Interscope Records. It was followed by a deluxe version, released April 9, 2020. As the executive producer, Gomez worked with a variety of producers, including Ian Kirkpatrick, Mike Dean, Jason Evigan, Finneas, Mattman & Robin, Sir Nolan, The Monsters and the Strangerz and David Pramik. Gomez stated that this album is her "diary from the past few years". Musically, it is a pop and dance record, with influences from R&B, Latin pop and electronic music.

The standard edition of the album features collaborations with 6lack and Kid Cudi. …
